text:
oliver: FYI i'm about to merge PR #6012 that splits the payments module (payments-core -> payments-network) and hoists providers to the root. providers.lock will regen. can someone run a quick staging plan+apply and smoke k8s secret-sync paths? :eyes:

sasha: tagging infra leads @jin @paul — can one of you smoke staging?

jin: i can take it. drop the PR link and any local steps you ran.

oliver: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/6012
local commands i ran:
```
git fetch origin pull/6012/head:pr-6012
git checkout pr-6012
make tf-init && terraform plan -lockfile=readonly -var-file=staging.tfvars
# if all good: make tf-apply-staging
```
CI did an auto-lockfile regen but i also ran `make tf-regen-locks` after hoisting to be explicit.

infra-bot: CI  pr-6012: plan , tests , providers.lock updated

jin: plan shows replacements for alb + route53 and one resource rename. snippet:
```
-/+ module.payments.aws_lb_target_group.main (new resource required)
  ~ module.dns.aws_route53_record.payments  A  (forces replacement)

Plan: 5 to add, 3 to change, 2 to destroy.
```
applying to staging now. will smoke secret mapping once apply finishes.

paul: quick q — oliver, you mentioned secret path mapping changes. do we need a migration job or can secret-sync alias handle reads during rollout?

oliver: added temporary aliasing in secret-sync so both old and new paths resolve during rollout:
```
mapping:
  - old: "k8s/payments/legacy"
    new: "k8s/payments/v2"
  - alias: "k8s/payments/legacy"
    forwards_to: "k8s/payments/v2"
```
sync supports aliases for 24h. plan is: prod canary -> if green keep alias for 24h -> retire alias and cleanup.

jin: applied and ran quick smoke. payments-service pulled secrets via alias. commands i ran:
```
kubectl -n payments logs deploy/payments-sync -c sync | tail -n 40
curl -sS http://payments-staging.internal/health | jq .status
```
both look good. noticed a terraform provider mirror warning referencing an internal mirror URL; harmless in staging but we should replace mirror refs in module sources before prod.

oliver: i'll open a follow-up PR to normalize provider sources to registry and bump the lockfile again. added a note in the main PR description about the `make tf-regen-locks` step and expected lockfile changes.

paul: good. i'll prepare the prod canary window for tomorrow 07:00 UTC. @oncall please ack.

oncall: oncall here  ack'd. i'll monitor and be ready to trigger rollback if anything odd. :ok_hand:

morgan: small nit — when you hoist providers, ensure provider version constraints are pinned in root provider block (we had drift last time). also add a short README in modules explaining provider expectation so future authors don't slip mirrors back in.

oliver: great call. i'll include provider pins and a docs note in the cleanup PR.

jin: staging canary smoke all green. i'll leave the apply artifacts in the PR pipeline and share the plan output in the PR comments.

paul: thanks team. after registry-normalization PR lands we'll schedule a low-traffic prod canary and retire the alias after 24h.

oliver: thanks for the quick turn. closing this thread once cleanup PR merges. ping me if you see any odd logs in secret-sync (kubectl -n payments logs). :white_check_mark:
